title: What is Nexora?
text:
# What is Nexora?

Nexora is an **AI Operating System** for modern teams — not a chatbot.

It connects your apps, understands business context, reasons over work, and **executes real actions** through live tool APIs (Slack, Notion, and expanding connectors).

## Positioning

- One AI. Every Tool. Complete Automation.
- Command surface for work — not slideware demos.
- Plans multi-step work before acting.
- Persistent workspace memory across tools and time.
- Human-in-the-loop approvals for high-impact steps.

## How Nexora differs from ChatGPT

| ChatGPT | Nexora |
|---------|--------|
| Answers questions | Executes work across your stack |
| No live tool ops by default | Live Slack & Notion API actions |
| Session chat | Persistent AI memory + history |
| Single assistant | Multi-agent OS with routing |
| No enterprise approval gates | Approvals, audit, roles |

Nexora is the **operating layer** between AI and the tools teams already use.

title: Product capabilities & features
text:
# Product capabilities & features

## Core OS layers

1. **AI Memory** — Persistent, contextual memory that improves over time so every interaction builds on the last.
2. **Reasoning Engine** — Plans multi-step work before acting; the OS core that turns intent into reliable execution.
3. **Tools** — Native integrations and extensible tools so Nexora can act securely across systems.
4. **Approvals** — Human-in-the-loop controls and policy guardrails for high-impact decisions.

## Feature grid (Why Nexora)

- AI Memory — Persistent workspace context across tools and time.
- Reasoning Engine — Plans multi-step work before acting.
- Tool Execution — Real Slack & Notion actions — not simulated chat.
- Approvals — Human-in-the-loop for high-impact steps.
- Live Integrations — Connected systems with health and sync status.
- Cross-Platform Actions — One command spans multiple apps.

## How it works (loop)

01 Understand → 02 Reason → 03 Plan → 04 Execute → 05 Learn → 06 Remember

A continuous loop — not a single prompt.

## Live commands (examples)

- Create a Notion page called Investor Notes
- Create a Slack channel called Marketing
- Summarize yesterday's Slack discussion
- Post "Deployment complete" to #engineering on Slack
- List channels on Slack
- Create a Notion page titled Weekly Report
- Show history for #marketing on Slack
- Generate product documentation in Notion

## Global Sync & performance

- Global Sync keeps work aligned across teams, tools, and regions.
- Lightning-fast design targets enterprise responsiveness (marketing claims ~12ms global latency class messaging for the OS layer experience).

title: Integrations
text:
# Integrations

Nexora connects the tools teams already use. Hover accordion and hub on the marketing site highlight:

## Live today

- **Slack** — Channels, messages, history, summaries. Critical context from threads becomes actionable. Live bot token / OAuth path depending on mode.
- **Notion** — Create and update pages in your workspace. Docs and launch plans stop being siloed.

## Featured / roadmap connectors (marketing surface)

- Gmail — Draft replies and route follow-ups.
- Jira — Bridge tickets to business context.
- Zoom — Capture decisions and next steps.
- Asana — Keep project context aligned.
- Microsoft 365 — Bring Office/SharePoint work into one execution layer.
- Discord — Route community signal into workflows.
- Salesforce — Connect CRM to real execution.
- GitHub — Mentioned in network visualizations; ask for current live status — Slack & Notion are the production live tools today.
- Google Drive / Calendar — Represented in product vision and network maps; not claimed as live API execution unless enabled.

## How Slack integration works

1. Connect Slack (demo shared credentials or per-user OAuth in SaaS mode).
2. Ask Nexora in natural language (create channel, post message, list channels, summarize discussion).
3. Reasoning + planning selects Slack tools.
4. High-impact actions can require **Approvals**.
5. Results return in chat with an observable execution trail.

## How Notion integration works

1. Connect Notion with an integration token / OAuth.
2. Ask to create or update pages (Investor Notes, Weekly Report, docs).
3. Pages are created in **your** Notion workspace via the API — not simulated.

## Honesty rule

If a connector is shown as marketing/roadmap but not live, say: "Shown on the marketing surface; live execution today is Slack and Notion. Others are on the roadmap."

title: AI Agents
text:
# AI Agents

Nexora includes specialist AI Agents that share one OS — memory, reasoning, and tools.

## Agent concept

- Specialists that share one operating layer.
- Living agent cards on the marketing site show specialists collaborating on real workflows.
- Agents route through understand → reason → plan → execute → learn → remember.

## What agents can do

- Interpret intent from chat.
- Retrieve workspace memory.
- Compile multi-step plans.
- Call live tools (Slack, Notion).
- Request approvals for high-risk steps.
- Write outcomes back into memory.

## Onboarding after signup

1. Register / login (email or Google depending on config).
2. Land in `/app/dashboard` (product workspace).
3. Connect integrations under `/app/integrations`.
4. Use Chat to issue commands.
5. Review Approvals for gated actions.
6. Admins manage users under `/app/admin`.

title: FAQ, security, privacy, enterprise, docs
text:
# FAQ, security, privacy, enterprise, docs

## FAQ (landing)

**What is Nexora?** An AI Operating System that connects your tools, reasons over context, and executes real work — not just answers questions.

**How does the AI work?** Intent classification, retrieval, planning, then tool execution against live APIs like Slack and Notion.

**How are integrations connected?** In demo mode via secure .env credentials; SaaS mode supports per-user OAuth when enabled.

**Can I use my own Slack?** Yes — your workspace bot token powers live channel and message actions.

**Can I connect my own Notion?** Yes — pages are created in your Notion workspace via your integration token.

**How secure is my data?** Encrypted tokens, JWT sessions, org isolation, and approval gates for high-impact actions.

**Does Nexora remember conversations?** Yes — chat history and workspace preferences persist in Postgres.

**Can multiple people collaborate?** Multi-user SaaS is built in and can be enabled when you are ready to scale.

## Enterprise

Enterprise page / posture: operate like a platform team — workspace management, organizations, teams, permissions, analytics, API keys, automation, developer APIs, admin console, audit logs. Enterprise plan adds SSO/SAML, custom SLAs, private deployment options.

## Privacy & Terms

Marketing pages at `/privacy` and `/terms` cover how workspace data is handled and terms of use. Tokens are encrypted; org isolation applies.

## Documentation

`/docs` — APIs, connectors, and operator guides. Product surface includes dashboard analytics, approvals, integrations health.

## Contact / About / Demo

- About: We build the operating layer between AI and the tools teams already use.
- Contact / Book Demo CTAs route to contact and auth flows.
- Start Free → `/register`; Login → `/login`; product home → `/app/dashboard`.

## Architecture (high level)

User prompt → Reasoning → Planning → Tool selection → Slack/Notion APIs → Execution → Success, with memory writes and optional approval gates. Observable timeline of steps. Analytics control plane shows live KPIs and activity.

title: Nexora — Work Action OS
text:
# Nexora — Work Action OS

Nexora is not a chatbot. It is a **Work Action OS** with a human gate.

## Exact product line (say this)

**Nexora proposes real work in Slack, Jira, and Notion — then waits for a human to Approve & run before anything executes.**

Short form:

**Propose → Approve → Act.**

## Beachhead loop

1. Ask in Chat (e.g. “Create a Jira ticket to track the vendor contract follow-up”)
2. Review in Approvals (risk, what will change, blast radius)
3. Approve & run — live tool execution with verification
4. Timeline / audit remembers what was decided

## Competitive wedge

- Glean finds information
- Sierra answers customers
- **Nexora executes work with a human gate** across the tools ops/PM teams already use (Slack + Jira + Notion)
